mapper.update: UPDATE TB_QUAL_DIAG_HISTORY SET STATUS = #{status}, END_DT = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('DONE','ERROR') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE END_DT END, ERROR_MSG = #{errorMsg}, TOTAL_VIOLATIONS = COALESCE(#{totalViolations}, TOTAL_VIOLATIONS), TOTAL_RULES = COALESCE(#{totalRules}, TOTAL_RULES), TOTAL_COLS = COALESCE(#{totalCols}, TOTAL_COLS) WHERE DIAG_ID = #{diagId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.DIAG_ID AS diagId, h.DM_ID AS dmId, dm.DM_NM AS dataModelNm, h.DIAG_TYPE AS diagType, h.DIAG_DT AS diagDt, h.END_DT AS endDt, h.STATUS AS status, h.TARGET_OBJ_LIST AS targetObjList, h.SAMPLE_RATE AS sampleRate, h.INCREMENTAL_YN AS incrementalYn, h.LAST_DIAG_DT AS lastDiagDt, h.TOTAL_RULES AS totalRules, h.TOTAL_COLS AS totalCols, h.TOTAL_VIOLATIONS AS totalViolations, h.EXEC_USER_ID AS execUserId, h.ERROR_MSG AS errorMsg, h.PROGRESS_DONE AS progressDone, h.PROGRESS_TOTAL AS progressTotal FROM TB_QUAL_DIAG_HISTORY h LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL dm ON dm.DM_ID = h.DM_ID WHERE h.DIAG_ID = #{diagId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_QUAL_DIAG_HISTORY SET PROGRESS_DONE = COALESCE(#{progressDone}, PROGRESS_DONE), PROGRESS_TOTAL = COALESCE(#{progressTotal}, PROGRESS_TOTAL) WHERE DIAG_ID = #{diagId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_QUAL_DIAG_HISTORY h JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL dm ON dm.DM_ID = h.DM_ID WHERE dm.DM_DS_ID = #{dsId} AND h.STATUS IN ('READY','RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_QUAL_PROFILE_RESULT ( DM_ID, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, DIAG_ID, TOTAL_CNT, NULL_CNT, DISTINCT_CNT, EMPTY_CNT, MIN_VAL, MAX_VAL, AVG_VAL, STD_VAL, MIN_LEN, MAX_LEN, TOP_VALUES, UPDATED_DT ) VALUES ( #{dmId}, #{objNm}, #{attrNm}, #{diagId}, #{totalCnt}, #{nullCnt}, #{distinctCnt}, #{emptyCnt}, #{minVal}, #{maxVal}, #{avgVal}, #{stdVal}, #{minLen}, #{maxLen}, #{topValues}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (DM_ID, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM) DO UPDATE SET DIAG_ID = EXCLUDED.DIAG_ID, TOTAL_CNT = EXCLUDED.TOTAL_CNT, NULL_CNT = EXCLUDED.NULL_CNT, DISTINCT_CNT = EXCLUDED.DISTINCT_CNT, EMPTY_CNT = EXCLUDED.EMPTY_CNT, MIN_VAL = EXCLUDED.MIN_VAL, MAX_VAL = EXCLUDED.MAX_VAL, AVG_VAL = EXCLUDED.AVG_VAL, STD_VAL = EXCLUDED.STD_VAL, MIN_LEN = EXCLUDED.MIN_LEN, MAX_LEN = EXCLUDED.MAX_LEN, TOP_VALUES = EXCLUDED.TOP_VALUES, UPDATED_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT DM_ID AS dmId, OBJ_NM AS objNm, ATTR_NM AS attrNm, DIAG_ID AS diagId, TOTAL_CNT AS totalCnt, NULL_CNT AS nullCnt, DISTINCT_CNT AS distinctCnt, EMPTY_CNT AS emptyCnt, MIN_VAL AS minVal, MAX_VAL AS maxVal, AVG_VAL AS avgVal, STD_VAL AS stdVal, MIN_LEN AS minLen, MAX_LEN AS maxLen, TOP_VALUES AS topValues, UPDATED_DT AS updatedDt FROM TB_QUAL_PROFILE_RESULT WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} ORDER BY OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM

SELECT rr.DIAG_ID AS diagId, rr.RULE_ID AS ruleId, r.RULE_NM AS ruleNm, r.RULE_TYPE AS ruleType, r.SEVERITY AS severity, rr.OBJ_NM AS objNm, rr.ATTR_NM AS attrNm, rr.TOTAL_CNT AS totalCnt, rr.VIOLATION_CNT AS violationCnt, rr.VIOLATION_RATE AS violationRate, rr.SAMPLE_CNT AS sampleCnt, rr.ERROR_MSG AS errorMsg FROM TB_QUAL_RULE_RESULT rr LEFT JOIN TB_QUAL_RULE r ON r.RULE_ID = rr.RULE_ID WHERE rr.DIAG_ID = #{diagId} ORDER BY rr.OBJ_NM, rr.ATTR_NM, r.RULE_NM

WITH col_clsf AS ( SELECT a.DM_ID, a.OBJ_NM, a.ATTR_NM, COALESCE(d.DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, '미분류') AS DOMAIN_CLSF_NM FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR a LEFT JOIN TB_TERMS t ON t.TERMS_NM = a.ATTR_NM_KR LEFT JOIN TB_DOMAIN d ON d.DOMAIN_NM = t.DOMAIN_NM ) SELECT COALESCE(cc.DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, '미분류') AS "domainClsfNm", COUNT(DISTINCT rr.OBJ_NM || '.' || rr.ATTR_NM) AS "colCnt", COUNT(*) AS "ruleCnt", SUM(COALESCE(rr.TOTAL_CNT, 0)) AS "totalCnt", SUM(COALESCE(rr.VIOLATION_CNT, 0)) AS "violationCnt", CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(rr.TOTAL_CNT,0)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 100.0 - SUM(COALESCE(rr.VIOLATION_CNT,0)) * 100.0 / SUM(rr.TOTAL_CNT) END AS "conformRate" FROM TB_QUAL_RULE_RESULT rr JOIN TB_QUAL_DIAG_HISTORY dh ON dh.DIAG_ID = rr.DIAG_ID LEFT JOIN col_clsf cc ON cc.DM_ID = dh.DM_ID AND cc.OBJ_NM = rr.OBJ_NM AND cc.ATTR_NM = rr.ATTR_NM WHERE rr.DIAG_ID = #{diagId} GROUP BY COALESCE(cc.DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, '미분류') ORDER BY "conformRate" NULLS LAST, "domainClsfNm"

WITH col_clsf AS ( SELECT a.DM_ID, a.OBJ_NM, a.ATTR_NM, COALESCE(d.DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, '미분류') AS DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, d.DOMAIN_NM FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR a LEFT JOIN TB_TERMS t ON t.TERMS_NM = a.ATTR_NM_KR LEFT JOIN TB_DOMAIN d ON d.DOMAIN_NM = t.DOMAIN_NM ) SELECT rr.OBJ_NM AS "objNm", rr.ATTR_NM AS "attrNm", COALESCE(cc.DOMAIN_NM, '') AS "domainNm", r.RULE_NM AS "ruleNm", r.RULE_TYPE AS "ruleType", rr.TOTAL_CNT AS "totalCnt", rr.VIOLATION_CNT AS "violationCnt", rr.VIOLATION_RATE AS "violationRate", (CASE WHEN rr.VIOLATION_RATE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 100.0 - rr.VIOLATION_RATE END) AS "conformRate", rr.RULE_ID AS "ruleId" FROM TB_QUAL_RULE_RESULT rr JOIN TB_QUAL_DIAG_HISTORY dh ON dh.DIAG_ID = rr.DIAG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_QUAL_RULE r ON r.RULE_ID = rr.RULE_ID LEFT JOIN col_clsf cc ON cc.DM_ID = dh.DM_ID AND cc.OBJ_NM = rr.OBJ_NM AND cc.ATTR_NM = rr.ATTR_NM WHERE rr.DIAG_ID = #{diagId} AND COALESCE(cc.DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, '미분류') = #{domainClsfNm} ORDER BY rr.VIOLATION_RATE DESC NULLS LAST, rr.OBJ_NM, rr.ATTR_NM

SELECT rr.RULE_ID AS "ruleId", COALESCE(r.RULE_NM, '(deleted)') AS "ruleNm", r.RULE_TYPE AS "ruleType", r.SEVERITY AS "severity", COUNT(*) AS "applyCnt", COUNT(DISTINCT rr.OBJ_NM || '.' || rr.ATTR_NM) AS "colCnt", SUM(COALESCE(rr.TOTAL_CNT, 0)) AS "totalCnt", SUM(COALESCE(rr.VIOLATION_CNT, 0)) AS "violationCnt", CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(rr.TOTAL_CNT,0)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 100.0 - SUM(COALESCE(rr.VIOLATION_CNT,0)) * 100.0 / SUM(rr.TOTAL_CNT) END AS "conformRate" FROM TB_QUAL_RULE_RESULT rr LEFT JOIN TB_QUAL_RULE r ON r.RULE_ID = rr.RULE_ID WHERE rr.DIAG_ID = #{diagId} GROUP BY rr.RULE_ID, r.RULE_NM, r.RULE_TYPE, r.SEVERITY ORDER BY "conformRate" NULLS LAST, "ruleNm"

SELECT DIAG_ID AS diagId, RULE_ID AS ruleId, OBJ_NM AS objNm, ATTR_NM AS attrNm, SEQ AS seq, PK_VALUES AS pkValues, VIOLATING_VAL AS violatingVal FROM TB_QUAL_VIOLATION_SAMPLE WHERE DIAG_ID = #{diagId} AND RULE_ID = #{ruleId} ORDER BY OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_QUAL_PROFILE_HISTORY ( DIAG_ID, DM_ID, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, TOTAL_CNT, NULL_CNT, DISTINCT_CNT, EMPTY_CNT, MIN_VAL, MAX_VAL, AVG_VAL, STD_VAL, MIN_LEN, MAX_LEN, DIAG_DT ) VALUES ( #{diagId}, #{dmId}, #{objNm}, #{attrNm}, #{totalCnt}, #{nullCnt}, #{distinctCnt}, #{emptyCnt}, #{minVal}, #{maxVal}, #{avgVal}, #{stdVal}, #{minLen}, #{maxLen}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT DIAG_ID AS diagId, DM_ID AS dmId, OBJ_NM AS objNm, ATTR_NM AS attrNm, TOTAL_CNT AS totalCnt, NULL_CNT AS nullCnt, DISTINCT_CNT AS distinctCnt, EMPTY_CNT AS emptyCnt, MIN_VAL AS minVal, MAX_VAL AS maxVal, AVG_VAL AS avgVal, STD_VAL AS stdVal, MIN_LEN AS minLen, MAX_LEN AS maxLen, DIAG_DT AS diagDt FROM TB_QUAL_PROFILE_HISTORY WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm} ORDER BY DIAG_DT DESC LIMIT 100
